name: Airwallex
summary: Airwallex issues multi-currency corporate cards from a business account. Employee cards can be virtual or physical, while company cards are virtual only. The Explore plan is $0 per user each month for up to 10 Spend users, and Grow costs $12 per user plus a platform fee.

facts.text: The cards page says employee cards can be virtual or physical, and company cards are virtual only.
Employee cards take daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or annual spend limits, and company cards take limits per transaction.
Card transactions sync with Xero, NetSuite or QuickBooks, per the cards page.
The cards FAQ says a US business can apply with an EIN, without a Social Security Number or personal guarantee, and that there is no underwriting or capital threshold.
The Explore plan lists up to 2% cash rebates on local USD spend, with terms that apply.

plans.name: Explore
plans.notes: Up to 10 free Spend users, with unlimited multi-currency corporate cards and zero international fees

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Adds a platform fee based on team size, and the amount is not published. Up to 250 Spend users, with NetSuite and Dynamics 365 Business Central sync

hiddenCosts: The Grow platform fee is not published.
The pricing page states monthly prices in USD, and availability of plans and card programs depends on the business's location.
